# 2 Kings Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 223v–224v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_003_page_001.jpg, 2KI_003_page_002.jpg, 2KI_003_page_003.jpg

---

**3:1** And-Yehoram son of-Achav became-king over Yisra'el in-Shomron in-the-eighteenth year of-Yehoshafat king of-Yehudah, and-he-reigned twelve years.

**3:2** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, only not as-his-father and-as-his-mother, for-he-removed the-pillar [matstsevat] of-the-Ba'al that his-father had-made.

**3:3** Only to-the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin, he-clung [davaq]; he-did-not turn-aside from-them.

**3:4** And-Mesha king of-Moav was a-sheep-breeder [noqed], and-he-returned [heshiv] to-the-king of-Yisra'el a-hundred thousand lambs and-a-hundred thousand rams — wool [tsemer].

**3:5** And-it-was at-the-death of-Achav, and-rebelled the-king of-Moav against the-king of-Yisra'el.

**3:6** And-went-out the-king Yehoram on-that day from-Shomron and-mustered [vayifqod] all Yisra'el.

**3:7** And-he-went and-sent to-Yehoshafat king of-Yehudah, saying: The-king of-Moav has-rebelled against-me. Will-you-go with-me to Moav to-battle? And-he-said: I-will-go-up; as-me, as-you; as-my-people, as-your-people; as-my-horses, as-your-horses.

**3:8** And-he-said: Which way shall-we-go-up? And-he-said: The-way of-the-wilderness of-Edom.

**3:9** And-went the-king of-Yisra'el and-the-king of-Yehudah and-the-king of-Edom, and-they-went-around a-journey of-seven days, and-there-was no water for-the-camp and-for-the-animals [behemah] that [were] at-their-feet.

**3:10** And-said the-king of-Yisra'el: Alas [ahah]! For YHWH has-called these three kings to-give-them into-the-hand of-Moav.

**3:11** And-said Yehoshafat: Is-there-not here a-prophet of-YHWH, that-we-may-inquire of-YHWH through-him? And-answered one from-the-servants of-the-king of-Yisra'el and-said: Here [is] Elisha son of-Shafat, who poured water upon the-hands of-Eliyahu.

**3:12** And-said Yehoshafat: The-word of-YHWH is with-him. And-went-down to-him the-king of-Yisra'el and-Yehoshafat and-the-king of-Edom.

**3:13** And-said Elisha to the-king of-Yisra'el: What [is there] to-me and-to-you [mah li va-lakh]? Go to the-prophets of-your-father and-to the-prophets of-your-mother. And-said to-him the-king of-Yisra'el: No, for YHWH has-called these three kings to-give-them into-the-hand of-Moav.

**3:14** And-said Elisha: As-YHWH of-hosts lives, before-whom I-stand, were-it-not that the-face of-Yehoshafat king of-Yehudah I-regard [nose'], I-would-not look to-you or-see-you.

**3:15** And-now, bring to-me a-musician [menaggen]. And-it-was as-the-musician played [ke-naggen ha-menaggen], and-came upon-him the-hand of-YHWH [yad YHWH].

**3:16** And-he-said: Thus says YHWH: Make this valley [nachal] trenches, trenches [gevim gevim].

**3:17** For thus says YHWH: You-shall-not see wind and-you-shall-not see rain, and-that valley shall-be-filled [with] water, and-you-shall-drink — you and-your-livestock and-your-animals.

**3:18** And-this is-light [naqal] in-the-eyes of-YHWH; he-will-also give Moav into-your-hand.

**3:19** And-you-shall-strike every fortified city and-every choice city, and-every good tree you-shall-fell, and-all springs of-water you-shall-stop-up, and-every good plot [of land] you-shall-ruin with-stones.

**3:20** And-it-was in-the-morning, at-the-time-of-the-offering [ke-'alot ha-minchah], and-behold — water [was] coming from-the-way of-Edom, and-was-filled the-land with-water.

**3:21** And-all Moav heard that the-kings had-come-up to-fight against-them, and-they-were-called-together [vayitsa'aqu] — all who-girded a-belt [choger chagor] and-upward — and-they-stood at the-border.

**3:22** And-they-rose-early in-the-morning, and-the-sun shone upon the-water, and-saw Moav from-opposite the-water red [adummim] as-blood.

**3:23** And-they-said: This [is] blood! The-kings have-surely-been-destroyed [hacharev nechervu] and-struck each-man his-fellow. And-now — to-the-plunder [la-shalal], Moav!

**3:24** And-they-came to the-camp of-Yisra'el, and-rose-up Yisra'el and-struck Moav, and-they-fled from-before-them. And-they-came into-it and-struck Moav.

**3:25** And-the-cities they-tore-down [yaharosu], and-on every good plot each-man cast his-stone and-filled-it, and-every spring of-water they-stopped-up, and-every good tree they-felled, until only in-Qir-Chareshet they-left its-stones. And-surrounded-it the-slingers and-struck-it.

**3:26** And-saw the-king of-Moav that the-battle was-too-strong for-him, and-he-took with-him seven-hundred men drawing sword to-break-through to the-king of-Edom, and-they-could-not.

**3:27** And-he-took his-son, the-firstborn [bekoro], who was-to-reign in-his-place, and-offered-him-up [vaya'alehu] [as] a-burnt-offering ['olah] upon the-wall. And-there-was great wrath [qetsef gadol] upon Yisra'el, and-they-departed from-upon-him and-returned to-the-land.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.4 — noqed:** Mesha is a *noqed* — a breeder/dealer of sheep. The same rare term is used of Amos (Amos 1:1). The Mesha Stele (Moabite Stone) independently confirms Moab's rebellion and provides Mesha's own perspective.

**v.11 — "poured water upon the hands of Elijah":** A circumlocution meaning Elisha served as Elijah's personal attendant. This is how Elisha is identified — by his service, not his miracles.

**v.15 — yad YHWH:** "The hand of the LORD" — the standard prophetic idiom for the onset of divine inspiration/ecstasy. Music is used to induce the prophetic state.

**v.27 — qetsef gadol:** "Great wrath" — the most debated verse in the chapter. Whose wrath? The Hebrew is deliberately ambiguous. It may be divine wrath (Chemosh's?), Moabite fury, or the horror that falls upon Israel at the sight of child sacrifice. The narrator does not explain; Israel simply withdraws.

*— EMET*
